name: message-scroller
origin: shadcn/ui, style: aria-nova. Built on @shadcn/react/message-scroller, not react-aria-components — upstream hasn't ported this one to the aria base yet.
description: An auto-scrolling viewport for chat message lists: sticks to the latest message as new ones arrive, and shows a jump-to-end/start button once the user scrolls away. Marked experimental here because it doesn't sit on react-aria-components like the rest of this registry.
